test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 02 March 2023)
subject: reasoning
question:
A question is given, followed by two statements numbered (I) and (II). You have to decide whether the data provided in the statements is sufficient to answer the question. Read both the statements and select the appropriate answer.

**Question: **Six people sit in two parallel rows. In Row 1 - J, K and L sit facing towards north, and in Row 2 - F, G and H sit facing towards south. Each person in a row faces a person in the other row. Who faces G?

**Statements:**

(I) H faces K; L faces an immediate neighbour of H.

(II) G sits at one of the extreme ends of the row; J sits to the immediate left of L.

options.text: Data in statements I and II together is sufficient to answer the question
Data in statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement I is not
Data in statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement II is not
Data in either statement I alone or statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question

solution:
**Given : **

 
• Six people sit in two parallel rows. 
 
• In Row 1 - J, K and L sit facing towards north. 
 
• In Row 2 - F, G and H sit facing towards south. 
 
• Each person in a row faces a person in the other row.

**Explanation : **

 
• **Statement (I) → **H faces K; L faces an immediate neighbor of H.

​As any specific position of H, L and K cannot be determined, so no specific answer can drawn from it as this statement gives many possibilities.

**So, statement (I) is not sufficient to answer the question.**

 
• Statement (II) → G sits at one of the extreme ends of the row; J sits to the immediate left of L.​

​As any specific position of G, J and L cannot be determined, so no specific answer can drawn from it as this statement gives many possibilities.

**So, statement (II) is not sufficient to answer the question.**

Now, Using both the statements :

 
• Statement (I) + Statement (II) → H faces K; L faces an immediate neighbor of H. ​G sits at one of the extreme ends of the row; J sits to the immediate left of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7346bb6f2792cbe41fbc3e52605d6203771f08d72b8ed7ffa0c4641422240935.png] ​

**So, using both the statements, J faces G. Thus data in statements I and II together is sufficient to answer the question.**

Hence, **"Option - (1)"** is the correct answer.
